correctness.rationale: For primitive synchronous chip-firing two-cycles on C_n, zero Laplacian of the sum of firing vectors forces every site to alternate firing. Threshold inequalities give exact local chip intervals, all within 0..3. The four-state weighted de Bruijn transfer matrix has characteristic polynomial (lambda+z)(lambda+z²)(lambda²-(z+z²)lambda-z³). Half its trace of nth powers enumerates temporal 2-orbits by conserved total mass. Complementation gives symmetry/mean 3n/2; dominant analytic root yields CLT variance n sqrt(2)/8. Independent direct two-step simulation exhaustively checked all 4^n chip vectors for n=3..8 versus a separate integer recurrence.
